name: [Portal] Password recovery screens + emails (UI)
description:
**Why?**
The recovery helper (`AdminUserHelper::createAndSaveRenewHashCrm`) already exists per `004-auth-wiring.md`. This issue is the 3 front-end screens + 2 transactional emails per Figma (same board as Login — the designer put both flows on one section).

**What?**
Build the email-entry, success, and new-password screens, plus the recovery-request and password-changed emails, per Figma ([node 22:71](https://www.figma.com/design/uyNyEpBk6MYXqjXprmXftl/Partner-Portal?node-id=22-71)).

**Acceptance Criteria**

- [ ] Email-entry screen matches frame 168:985
- [ ] Success confirmation on the login page matches frame 168:1703 (Alert/Success)
- [ ] New-password screen matches frame 182:1820
- [ ] Recovery-request email (180:805) and password-changed confirmation email (234:894) sent in CZ/SK/HU/EN
- [ ] Recovery hash: 6-hour expiry, single-use; reuse shows "token expired" (per 004-auth-wiring.md)
- [ ] `make fe-test` covers all 3 screens

**Resources**

- Figma: https://www.figma.com/design/uyNyEpBk6MYXqjXprmXftl/Partner-Portal?node-id=22-71&m=dev
- Backend wiring: `Partner_Portal/issues/03-user-management/004-auth-wiring.md`
- i18n/emails: `Partner_Portal/issues/03-user-management/006-i18n-emails.md`
